-- T3c's shared values (R0 Task 7.1a, D1 spec §10): a header and a
-- minted variable, so each rejected fixture is one small declaration.
-- This module and Accepted.purs must compile.
module Test.ElabScope.Common
  ( header
  , minted
  , site
  ) where

import Data.Set as Set
import Domain.Recorded.Atom (CheckedName(..), Role(..), VarSort(..))
import Domain.Recorded.Origin (Path(..), PathRoot(..), RuleId(..))
import Domain.Resolved (FunctionId(..))
import Features.Check.Generate.Assemble (Header)
import Features.Check.Generate.Gen (Minted)

header ∷ Header
header =
  { decl: FunctionId 0
  , holders: { declared: Set.empty, holding: Set.empty }
  }

site ∷ CheckedName
site = NodeType body

minted ∷ Minted
minted =
  { path: body
  , role: Res
  , sort: SortType
  , position: site
  , rule: ExprRule 1
  , span: { start: origin, end: origin }
  }
  where
  origin = { line: 1, column: 1, offset: 0 }

body ∷ Path
body = Path { root: InBody, steps: [] }
